canonical_rule: The fast-forward-only Sable canonical sequential branch remains authoritative for all commits and pushes.
validation_rule: Run round-robin and v644-v7 scoped checks in the canonical lane, then exactly one additional bounded replay in a fresh clean named Sable validation lane.
required_properties: no push and no canonical authority
forbidden: full repository suite by this non-Eiren owner
history rewrite, force push, merge, or sibling mutation
boundary: The named lane is one bounded same-owner replay, not a canonical cutover, exhaustive validation, or independent reproduction.
